s: klI, (lohitasya BAvaH । lohita + zyaY .) lohitatvam । iti medinI । ye, 102 ॥

puM, (lohita eva । svArTe zyaY .) nadaBedaH । sa ca brahmaputtraH । iti medinI । ye, 102 ॥ sAgaraH । iti SabdamAlA ॥ tasya nadaviSezasya utpattiryaTA, -- sagara uvAca । “amoGAyAM kaTaM jajYe lOhityo brahmaRaH sutaH । kaTaM SAntanuBAryyAyAM rataH sa kamalAsanaH ॥ pArastrEReyaputtro vA kaTaM jajYe pitAmahAt । tat sarvvaM SrotumicCAmi kaTayasva dvijottama ॥ Orvva uvAca । SfRu tvaM nfpaSArddUla kaTayAmi mahattaram । AKyAnaM brahmaputtrasya lOhitasya mahAtmanaH ॥ harivarze mahAvarze SAntanurnAma nAmataH । munirAsInmahABAgo jYAnavAn sutapoDanaH ॥ tasya BAryyA mahABAgA amoGAKyA mahAsatI । hiraRyagarBasya munestfRavfndASramodBavA ॥ tayA sArdDaM sa kElAsamaryyAdAparvvate'vasat । lohityAKyasya sarasastIre vE ganDamAdane ॥ ekadA sa taponizWo nijapuzpAdigocare । jagAma vanamaDyantu cinvan bahuPalAni ca ॥ tasminnavasare brahmA sarvvalokapitAmahaH । tatrAjagAma yatrAsti amoGA SAntanoH priyA ॥ tAM dfzwvA hemagarBABAM yuvatImatisundarIm । mohito madanenASu taTABUddUzitendriyaH ॥ udIritendriyo BUtvA jiGfkzustAM mahAsatIm । aTADAvattadA brahmA saMmuKo madanArdditaH ॥ DAvamAnaM viDAtAraM dfzwvAmoGA mahAsatI । mEvaM mEvamiti proktvA parRaSAlAM vyalIyata ॥ idaYcovAca DAtAramamoGA kupitA tadA । parRaSAlAttaragatA dvAramAvftya tatkzaRAt ॥ akAryyaM na mayA kAryyaM munipatnyA vigarhitam । balAt pramaTye cAhaM tattvayA tvAYca SapAmyaham ॥ amoGayA cEvamukte viDAtuSca tadA nfpa । retaScaskanda ca tadEvASrame SAntanormuneH ॥ cyute retasi DAtApi haMsayAnaM samAsTitaH । lajjayAtiparItAtmA drutaM vE svASramaM yayO ॥ gate veDasiM SAntanurnijamASramamAgataH । Agatya dfzwvA hasAnAM padakzoBaM taTA Buvi ॥ tejaSca patitaM BUmO viDAturjvalanopamam । amoGAM paripapracCa parRaSAlAntarasTitAm ॥ kimetadatra SuBage pravfttaM dfSyate tu yat । pakziRAYca padakzoBaM tejaScedaYca kIdfSam ॥ sA tasya vacana SrutvA SAntanuM munisattamam । amarziteva nyagadadAkulA vikalAnanA ॥ haMsayuktasyandanena ko'pyAgatya caturmuKaH । kamaRqalukaro BIrU ratiM mAM samayAcata ॥ tato mayA martsitaSca uwajAntaralInayA । pracyAvya tejaH saMyAto mama SApaBayArdditaH ॥ kuru tatra pratIkAraM yadi Saknozi SAntano । na hi mAM DarzaRAM soQuM kaScit Sakroti jIvaBft ॥ sa tasyA vacanaM SrutvA svayaM brahmA samAgataH । iti niScitya manasA tatra DyAnaparo'Bavat ॥ divyaDyAnena tajjYAtvA devakAryyamupasTitam । tIrTAvatAraRaYcApi hitAya jagatAM muniH ॥ DyAtvodarkaM cintayitvA svaBAryyAmidamabravIt । idaM tejo brahmaRastvaM pibAmoGe mamAjYayA ॥ hitAya sarvvajagatAM devakAryyArTasidDaye । BavatyA nikawaM brahmA svayameva samAgataH ॥ tvAmaprApya mahAkftyamAvayoH sa samarpya ca । gato nijAspadaM tattvaM karttumarhasi tadvacaH ॥ tat SrutvA SAntanorvvAkyamamoGAtIva lajjitA । sAntvayantIva taM prAha patiM natvA mahAsatI ॥ nAnyasya tejo DAsyAmi na cette vimanaskatA । avaSyaM yadi karttavyaM pItvA tvaM mayi cotsfja ॥ tatastasyA vacaH SrutvA yuktaM taTyaYca SAntanuH । svayaM pItvA ca tattejastasyA garBe vyasecayat ॥ saMkrAmitEH SAntanunA tejoBirbrahmaRaH satI । garBaM daDAnAmoGAKyA hitAya jagatAM tataH ॥ tasyAM kAle tu saMprApte saMjAto jalasaYcayaH । tanmaDye tanayaScApi nIlavAsAH kirIwaDfk ॥ ratnamAlAsamAyukto raktagOraSca brahmavat । caturBujaH padmavidyADaraSaktiDarastaTA ॥ SiSuBAraSiraHsTaSca tulyakAyo jalotkarEH । taM jAtaYca taTA BUtaM SAntanurlokaSAntanuH । caturRAM parvvatAnAYca maDyadeSe nyaveSayat ॥ kElAsaScottare pArSve dakziRe ganDamAdanaH । jAruDiH paScime SElaH pUrvve sambarttakAhvayaH ॥ tezAM maDye svayaM kuRqaM parvvatAnAM viDeH sutaH । kftvAtivavfDe nityaM SaradIva niSAkaraH ॥ taM toyamaDyagaM puttramAsAdya druhiRaH svayam । kramatastasya saMskArAnakaroddehaSudDaye ॥ aTa kAle bahutiTe vyatIte brahmaRaH sutaH । toyarASisvarUpeRa vavfDe paYcayojanAn ॥ tasmin devAH papuH sasnurdvitIya iva sAgare । SItAmalajale hfdye devyaScApsarasAM gaREH ॥ tasminnavasare rAmo jAmadagnyaH pratApavAn । cakre mAtfvaDaM GoramatyugraM piturAjYayA ॥ tasya pApasya mokzAya svapituScopadeSataH । sa jagAma mahAkuRqaM brahmAKyaM snAtumicCayA ॥ tatra snAtvA ca pItvA ca mAtfhatyAM vyapAnayat । vITIM paraSunA kftvA taYca kzmAmavatArayat ॥” iti kAlikApurARe jAmadagnyopAKyAne 84 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ api ca । “jAtasaMpratyayaH so'Ta tIrTamAsAdya taM varam । vITIM paraSunA kftvA brahmaputtramavAhayat ॥ brahmakuRqAt sutaH so'Ta kAsAre lohitAhvaye । kElAsopatyakAyAntu nyapatadbrahmaRaH sutaH ॥ tasyApi sarasastIraM samutTAya mahAbalaH । kuWAreRa diSaM pUrvvAmanayadbrahmaRaH sutam ॥ tato'paratrApi giriM hemaSfNgaM viBidya ca । kAmarUpAntaraM pIWamavAhayadamuM hariH ॥ tasya nAma viDiScakre svayaM lohitagaNgakam । lohityAt saraso jAto lOhityAKyastato 'Bavat ॥ sa kAmarUpamaKilaM pIWamAplAvya vAriRA । gopayan sarvvatIrTAni dakziRaM yAti sAgaram ॥ prAgeva divyayamunAM saMtyaktvA brahmaRaH sutaH । punaH patati lOhitye gatvA dvAdaSayojanam ॥ cEtre mAsi sitAzwamyAM yo naro niyatendriyaH । snAti lOhityatoyezu sa yAti brahmaRaH padam ॥ cEtrantu sakalaM mAsaM SuciH prayatamAnasaH । lOhityatoye yaH snAti sa kEvalyamavApnuyAt ॥” iti kAlikApurARe 85 aDyAyaH ॥

(ifc.) belonging to the world of (cf. ब्रह्म-ल्˚)

लौकिक n. anything occurring in the world, general custom, usage, Śak.; MārkP.

a: लौकिक — a. (की f.) [लोके विदितः प्रसिद्धो हितो वा ठण्] 1 Worldly, mundane, terrestrial, earthly. --2 General, common, usual, ordinary, vulgar; U. 1. 10. --3 Of every-day life, generally accepted, popular, customary; Ku. 7. 88. --4 Temporal, secular (opp. आर्ष or शास्त्रीय); Ms. 3. 282. --5 Not sacred, profane (as a word or its sense); वाक्यं द्विविधं वैदिकं लौकिकं च T. S.; (see Mbh. quoted under लोक 8). --6 Belonging to the world of; as in ब्रह्मलौकिक. --काः (pl.) 1 Ordinary men, men of the world. --2 The human race, mankind. --कं Any general or worldly custom. --Comp. --ज्ञ a. knowing the ways of the world, acquainted with worldly customs; वनौकसोपि संतो लौकिकज्ञा वयं Ś. 4.

लौलक or लौलिक m. N. of a poet, Cat.
लौल्य n. (fr. लोल) restlessness, Suśr.
unsteadiness, inconstancy, fickleness, Hariv.
lustfulness, eagerness, greediness, passion, ardent longing for (loc. or comp.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: लौल्यं — [लोलस्य भावः प्यञ्] 1 Fickleness, unsteadiness, inconstancy. --2 Eagerness, eager desire, greediness; lustfulness, excessive passion or desire; जिह्वालौल्यात् Pt. 1; R. 7. 61, 16. 76; 18. 31.

m: लौल्य—ता f. lustfulness, eager desire, BhP.
लौल्य—वत् mfn. eagerly desirous, avaricious, lustful, Kathās.
लौमायन mfn. (fr. लोमन्), g. पक्षादि;
pl., see next.

लौम mfn. (fr. लोमन्) g. संकलादि and शर्करादि.
लौमशीय mfn. (fr. लोमश) g. कृशाशादि.
लौमहर्षणक mf(इका)n. composed by Loma-harṣaṇa, BhP., Introd.
लौमहर्षणि m. patr. fr. लोम-हर्षण, MBh.
लौमकायन mfn. (fr. लोमक) g. पक्षादि.
लौमकायनि m. patr. fr. लोमक, g. तिकादि.
लौमकीय mfn. (fr. लोमक) g. कृताश्वादि.
लौमन (cf. Pāṇ. vi, 4, 167) and लौम˚न्य, mfn. (fr. लोमन्), g. संकाशादि.
लौमि m. patr. fr. लोमन्, g. बाह्व्-आदि.

a: लौड् — {c1c} P. (लौडति) To be foolish or mad.
